meta.provenance: Generated by scripts/build-catalog.ts on 2026-08-19 from the HYG database (https://codeberg.org/astronexus/hyg, CC BY-SA 4.0), merged with src/data/catalog-overlay.json for system names, stable ids, notes, and the WISE/2MASS brown dwarfs that HYG's Gliese-Jahreiss lineage predates. Components within 0.3 ly of one another are grouped into a single system. Do not hand-edit: rerun the script instead.

systems.name: Sol
systems.note: Origin of the coordinate system.

systems.name: Alpha Centauri
systems.note: Proxima is 4.246 ly and gravitationally bound but sits ~2° off A/B on the sky.

systems.name: Barnard's Star
systems.note: Largest known proper motion of any star: 10.3" per year.

systems.name: Luhman 16
systems.note: Nearest brown dwarf binary. Discovered 2013.

systems.name: WISE 0855−0714
systems.note: Coldest known object outside the Solar System, around 250 K.

systems.name: Luyten 726-8
systems.note: UV Ceti is the prototype flare star.

systems.name: Sirius
systems.note: Brightest star in Earth's night sky.

systems.name: Ross 248
systems.note: Will be the nearest star to the Sun in roughly 36,000 years.

systems.name: Epsilon Eridani
systems.note: Young star with a debris disk and a confirmed giant planet.

systems.name: 61 Cygni
systems.note: First star to have its parallax measured (Bessel, 1838).

systems.name: Tau Ceti
systems.note: Nearest single Sun-like star. Long-standing SETI target.

systems.name: Ragnarok
systems.note: Story location with no catalogue counterpart; position estimated by the bobiverse-map project.

systems.name: Luyten's Star
systems.note: Lies only 1.2 ly from Procyon and appears beside it on the sky.

systems.name: Kapteyn's Star
systems.note: Halo subdwarf on a retrograde galactic orbit; roughly 11 Gyr old.

systems.name: Van Maanen's Star
systems.note: Nearest solitary white dwarf.

systems.name: Wolf 1061
systems.note: Hosts three known planets, one near the habitable zone.

systems.name: GJ 876
systems.note: Four known planets, including two in a 2:1 resonance.

systems.name: AD Leonis
systems.note: Well-studied flare star.

systems.name: 40 Eridani
systems.note: Also Omicron² Eridani. First white dwarf ever identified.

systems.name: Altair
systems.note: Rotates near breakup speed; visibly oblate.

systems.name: GJ 445
systems.note: Voyager 1 passes within ~1.6 ly of this star in about 40,000 years.

systems.name: Gliese 229
systems.note: GJ 229 B was the first unambiguously confirmed brown dwarf (1995).

systems.name: Gliese 752
systems.note: VB 10 is one of the least luminous stars known.

systems.name: Delta Pavonis
systems.note: Nearest subgiant; a frequent target in habitability studies.

systems.name: Gliese 892
systems.note: Hosts a transiting super-Earth; nearest known transiting planet host.

systems.name: Odin
systems.note: Story location with no catalogue counterpart; position estimated by the bobiverse-map project.

systems.name: Beta Hydri
systems.note: Close analogue of the Sun's future as it leaves the main sequence.

systems.name: Vega
systems.note: Sits essentially on the 25 ly shell. Photometric zero point for the Vega magnitude system.

systems.name: Fomalhaut
systems.note: Just outside 25 ly. Famous for its sharply defined debris ring.

systems.name: Pi3 Orionis
systems.note: Catalogued under its IAU name Tabit.

systems.name: Delta Eridani
systems.note: Catalogued under its IAU name Rana. Bob's second stop, and home of the Deltans.

systems.name: HIP 84051
systems.note: Called New Pav in the books. Position is an estimate from the bobiverse-map project — no catalogue counterpart inside 35 ly.
